title: Close the rear wrap's preview opening
notes: The optional ragged-wrap drape now clears the rear body below its waist attachment, closing the small skin opening seen in the previous preview.
The new coverage check uses drawn character shapes and triangle interiors, and challenges the result with a deliberately buried panel. Existing saved characters retain their shapes and equipment.
The preview still needs better tailoring, seams, fraying and cloth motion. Its angular panels and thick waist band remain unfinished; ordinary launches keep the shipped geometry.
